## General information

Subject: `r sample`

Species: `r species`

```{r check_files}

summary_file = paste0(sample,"_summary.txt")
regions_status <- read.csv(summary_file, header = F, sep = " ")

colnames(regions_status) <- c("Sample","Hap","Region","Lib","Status")
regions_status <- regions_status[regions_status$Status == "annotated",]
```

```{r annotation, results='asis'}

for (region in sort(unique(regions_status$Region))) {
  cat(paste0("### Region: ", region, " {.tabset}\n"))
  
  regions_annotation <- subset(regions_status, Region == region)
  for (hap in sort(unique(regions_annotation$Hap))) {
    cat(paste0("#### Haplotype: ", hap, "\n"))
    regions_hap <- subset(regions_annotation, Hap == hap)
    
    for (lib in sort(unique(regions_hap$Lib))) {
      cat(paste0("##### ", lib, "\n"))
      annote_image <- paste0(region,"/annotation/",sample,"_",hap,"_",region,"_report_",lib,".svg")
      if (file.exists(annote_image)) {
        cat(paste0("![](", annote_image, ")\n"))
      } else {
        cat(paste0("Image file not found: ", annote_image, "\n"))
      }
      
      csv_files = paste0(region,"/",sample,"_",hap,"_",region,"_final_",lib,".csv")
      annotation_data <- read.csv(csv_files, sep = '\t', header = T)
      print (knitr::kable(annotation_data))
    
    }
  }
#  print (regions_annotation)
#  final_csv_files <- list.files(region, pattern = paste0(".*", region, ".*final.*\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
#  print (final_csv_files)

}

```


```{r}
knitr::knit_exit()
```


```{r results='asis'}

# Loop through unique samples
  for (region in unique(sample_data$region)) {
    cat(paste0("### Region: ", region, " {.tabset}\n"))

    region_data <- subset(sample_data, region == region)

    # Loop through unique haplotypes
    for (haplotype in unique(region_data$haplotype)) {
      cat(paste0("#### Haplotype: ", haplotype, "\n"))
      cat("\n")
      
      annote_table <- region_data[region_data$haplotype == haplotype & region_data$region == region, ]$file_path
      annote_image <- gsub("_final\\.tsv$", ".svg", annote_table)
      
      if (file.exists(annote_image)) {
        cat(paste0("![](", annote_image, ")\n"))
      } else {
        cat(paste0("Image file not found: ", annote_image, "\n"))
      }
      
      table_data <- read.table(annote_table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
      table_data$contig <- NULL
      print (knitr::kable(table_data))
    }
  }
}
```






```{r check_files2}

status_file <- paste0(sample,"_",region,"_status.csv")
filter_file <- paste0(path,"/",sample,"_",region,"_final.tsv")
fasta_file <- paste0(path,"/",sample,"_",region,"_intact.fa")
bed_file <- paste0(path,"/",sample,"_",region,"_intact.bed")
image_file <- paste0(path,"/",sample,"_",region,"_report.svg")
```


```{r general_info, echo = FALSE}

flanks <- read.csv(paste0(sample,"_",region,"_status.csv"), header = F, sep = "\t")

if ("flanks" %in% flanks$V1){
  if ("closed" %in% flanks$V2){
    roi = "intact"
    contig = flanks$V4
  }
}

left_flank = gsub("/.*", "", flanks$V3)
right_flank = gsub(".*/", "", flanks$V3)
```

Species: `r species`

Left flank: `r left_flank`

Right flak: `r right_flank`

Region of interest status: `r roi`

ROI's contig: `r contig`

## Annotation

```{r display_svg, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='100%'}

knitr::include_graphics(image_file)

```


### Mapped Fragments


```{r table, }

candidates <- read.csv(filter_file, header = T, sep = "\t" )

replace_strand <- function(df, strand_column = "strand") {
  df[[strand_column]] <- ifelse(df[[strand_column]] == "-", "neg", 
                                ifelse(df[[strand_column]] == "+", "pos", 
                                       df[[strand_column]]))
  return(df)
}

candidates <- replace_strand(candidates)

kable(candidates) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "striped")
```
